title: maint.event.v1{kind=spool_flush_partial}
description: Phase 8 §8.14.10 — emitted when a spool-flush invocation exhausts its drain budget (cfg.opsctl_spool_flush_max_per_run) without emptying the spool directory. Carries the drained + remaining counts so the operator knows when to re-run. No ack expected.

target.description: Agent or subsystem whose spool directory was flushed (e.g. 'opsctl' or 'agent_spool/<agent>').

produced_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this notification was emitted.

flush_run_id.description: Unique ID for this flush invocation (UUID4). Correlates with audit rows and the directory-level flock.

drained.description: Number of spool entries re-published in this flush run.

remaining.description: Number of spool entries still on disk after this flush run. 0 means the spool is fully empty.
